steps.name: Radio Broadcast
steps.text: It's already been two weeks since we said 'so long' to our volcano. My dear Siestans, do you already miss that spectacular eruption?

steps.name: Radio Broadcast
steps.text: I wonder, what was going through everyone's minds at that moment? After all, it was a once-in-a-lifetime occurrence—or at least I certainly hope so!

steps.name: Radio Broadcast
steps.text: 'Thank goodness I'm still alive!' 'That's it? It's over already?' ...Or maybe, 'Adios, Old Siesta!'

steps.name: Radio Broadcast
steps.text: To be honest, there was only one thing on MY mind at the time: What would it be like to reach out and grab a chunk of that volcanic cloud from the sky? Would it have tasted like a tomato, or a strawberry-flavored marshmallow?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: It's almost ready. Want to add anything? Strawberry jam or ketchup?

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: Give it to me with cotton candy!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: That's not a thing, Captain Lut. Here you go.

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: I'm not the captain today, I'm the colonel.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Fine by me, Colonel Lut. Hopefully you like strawberry jam. Which would you like, Liv?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Liv?

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: (Do you want some too?)

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: (But Enis only made so much. If you also have some, then there won't be enough for Harley!)

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: (How about this: I'll give you half of mine. Sound good?)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (Is Liv... having a conversation with thin air?)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (She's not sleeptalking, is she?)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (Sleepyhead.)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (Maybe I should just make it half-and-half.)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Here you go, Liv. Half jam, half ketchup.

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: That's no fair, Enis!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Fine, fine. Ketchup for Colonel Lut as well.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Now for a pop quiz—

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: If me and Harley aren't home, and you two have to cook for yourselves, what's the first thing you do after you're done?

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: Turn off the stove—

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: That one's too easy. You asked the same question the day before.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: And your answer, Liv?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Hey, Liv— Don't start running off after only taking a single bite! Liv!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: ...Now why the heck would she just run off like that?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (Liv's been acting strange all day... Could she be spacing out because she's upset that I'm leaving?)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (Maybe I need to sit down and have a talk with her. Might be worth taking her to a pet store before I go, see if I can find her a friend to keep her company.)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Whoa! My fried egg...

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: Enis! Didn't I just say to turn off the stove after you finish cooking?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Ahaha... Y'know how it goes: do as I say, not as I do.

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: *sigh*... One of you ran off without finishing her breakfast, and the other messed up his own breakfast.

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: But Colonel Lut here sat down at the table and ate his breakfast without a fuss. Don't I deserve a reward?

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: What would you like?

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: A D32 steel warrior.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Heh, well, I happen to have my own idea. How about I conveniently forget that you used my lip balm to scribble all over the drinks menu?

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: That wasn't me, Harley! H-How about we compromise? I'll just ask Enis to make me another omelet!

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Good kids don't haggle. The more you try, the less you're getting out of me.

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: Hmph! Fine, then I'm leaving too!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Where are you going to play today, Lut?

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: Not telling!

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Is this one mine?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Yup. With pepper, as usual.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Just give me that overcooked mess you have sitting in the pan over there.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Hey, it's not that burnt... I can still eat it.

spans.text: burnt... I can still eat it.

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: (Reaches for cup)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Wait, Lut! That's... Don't drink that!

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (Sniffs)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Harley! How many times have I told you not to leave leftover drinks on the bar? The kids aren't—

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Yeah, yeah. A sip or two of orange ale's not gonna kill them; stop being such a worrywart. You've turned into more of a mom than me lately.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: People who can't take it easy before 'the Big Day' can't possibly become globetrotting explorers.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: That's a completely different issue...

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Musicians before a performance don't have the time to worry about other people having their strings on right. Sort out your own affairs before worrying about us.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: You'll be leaving in a few days. Have you figured out the work situation yet?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Three, two, one... Hup!

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Hey hey hey, slow down... I've got this side secured. On my mark, lift—

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: And liiiift—

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Phew... Alright, that should be the last box. The terminal shows there's still a batch of goods yet to be delivered to Siesta. Once everything arrives, would you mind moving it all to the warehouse and taking a detailed inventory?

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Don't worry, it's an order from Mountaincomm Trade. As long as there's money to be made, you can count on me.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Oh, but a whole bunch of urgent shipments have been coming in recently. Without you to split the workload with, I might be out making nighttime deliveries...

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: So, Enis, are you absolutely positive about leaving Siesta?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Mmhmm. I've made up my mind.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Sure didn't see that coming... Guess that means the journey to revitalize Siesta's tourism industry is short another pair of capable hands.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: C'mere, gimme a hug. Have a safe journey.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: What's with all the touchy-feely stuff? It's not like I'm never coming back...

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: You're an old friend I'm used to meeting every day. 'Course I don't want to see you go!

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Must be even harder for your family, though, seeing how tight you all are. We only just finished sorting out Fashion Street's grand renovation, and now they have to say goodbye again. It truly is just...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Harley actually didn't make much of a fuss over it. She was kind of a free spirit when she was younger, so I figure she wants me to go out there and take my shot.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: As for the siblings, it might take them some time to adjust.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: It's been on my mind the last few days, too—is there anything I can leave for them?

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Hey, Enis, that kid walking down the road talking to herself... Is that your sister?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: That she is... Strange.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Lemme go take a look.
The towering crane stretches out its long arms, its hanging cable slowly cutting through the unbroken, pillowy clouds in the sky.
In the distance, Mount Siesta intermittently coughs up plumes of gray smoke. It's been wheezing like that ever since its tantrum two weeks ago.

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: The jam half of the omelet is yours.

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: Grandpa Tom didn't open the store today, so I wasn't able to get you any ice cream.

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: But the jam tastes really good, too. Enis made it himself. Enis...

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: ...Liv? Why'd she come out to the undeveloped plot again?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: She ran over here by herself when the volcano erupted... Could the tsunami back then have given her some sort of trauma? No, she'd be avoiding this place then...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: It's closer here, and I can almost hear her clearly. I hope she doesn't notice me...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Huh? She seems to have... some sort of furry creature with her? Is that what Liv was talking to this whole time?

steps.name: Cheerful Creature
steps.text: *nom* *nom*

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: This is a little clay doll that Enis made for me. She has curly hair and a tiny flower tucked behind her ear. Do you think she looks like me? Enis said he made her with magic.

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: He's a liar. He doesn't know any magic. In the storybooks, magicians have all sorts of mystical, amazing powers, and they definitely never get sick.

steps.name: Cheerful Creature
steps.text: (Grunts in dissatisfaction)

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: Huh? Are you saying that even magicians can get sick?

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: Then, I'd rather Enis not be a magician.

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: I just wish he never got the stone disease.

steps.name: Cheerful Creature
steps.text: (Grunts softly)

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: The doctor lady said that it isn't that serious. But he ended up sleeping in the hospital for three whole days back then...

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: I heard from the adults on Fashion Street that people who get stone disease slowly turn to rock. Then they can't move or talk, and end up turning to sand and blowing away with the wind.

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: I... don't want that to happen to Enis.

steps.name: Cheerful Creature
steps.text: (Nuzzles up close)

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: Lately, he's been acting really strange. He seems so nervous. Do you think it's because of the 'Oripathy'?

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: Good thing he'll be leaving soon. To ship called Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Cheerful Creature
steps.text: (Grunts in confusion)

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: ...Of course not. Of course I don't want him to go.

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: But, Harley said there's lots and lots of amazing doctors on that ship, and I'm sure they'll find a cure for Enis's stone disease!

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: As long as he gets better, everything will be okay.

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: As for Fashion Street... You and Harley will be with me, right? Yeah, that's right. And that dummy Lut. We can all wait for Enis to come back, together.

steps.name: Cheerful Creature
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: And here I was thinking she didn't want me to leave. But she's actually been worried about my condition this whole time.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Get it together, Enis. You can't go making your sister worry about you—

steps.name: Cheerful Creature
steps.text: (Turns head)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Shoot—

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: The fuzzy thing... noticed me?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Speaking of which, I think I saw that exact same creature when the tsunami hit.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: So it wasn't just a dream after all... Are they the ones who protected me, Liv, and all of Siesta?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Liv also made a new friend.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: This is... a text message from Grandpa Tom?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Grandpa Tom!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Grandpa Tom?

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Shh! Pipe down!

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: I'm up here, on the awning. Look up.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: What are you doing up there? You sent so many exclamation marks I thought this was urgent... You didn't open the shop today either, so I was fearing the worst—

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Not my fault you've got an overactive imagination, brat! I've got plenty of life in me yet!

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Now cut the crap and get up here already!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Huh? What for...?

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: You'll know when you get up here, you stinkin' rascal!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Alright then...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: What's the big deal about this awning anyway? Surely you didn't invite me up here to catch some afternoon Siestan rays.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Look over there—

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Hmm? Isn't that little boy...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Lut? What's he doing in front of the music shop?

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Working. Been seeing him a lot lately. Seems like he's helping attract customers.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Working? Him, of all people?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Now that I think about it though, I haven't seen him much lately. And he's been pretty tight-lipped whenever I asked him what he's been doing. I was wondering.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Is it because he doesn't have enough spending money? Don't tell me he's saving up for that D32 steel warrior...

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Oi, oi. You're the older brother, aren't you? If you wanna treat them like your own kids, you'd best pay attention to how fast they grow!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: How fast... they grow?

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Uh-huh. The boy seems to have taken an interest in musical instruments. As expected of a kid who grew up on Fashion Street.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: The music shop's owner mentioned to me that he was asking about the price of a guitar, and said he wanted to learn.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Seems like the guitar skills Harley keeps under wraps these days have finally been passed down.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: But he's too young for that... If he really wants one, he could've just asked me.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I'll talk to the shop owner.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Oi, you blockhead. Don't put a damper on his enthusiasm.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: You big brother types are always so stuck up. Wanting to do everything for your siblings, acting like they couldn't live without you.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: If you ask me, it's the other way around. You can't live without them!

spans.text: If you ask me, it's the other way around. You can't live without

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: But... that's how our relationship's always been.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: It's precisely because I'm leaving that I should do whatever I can for them. I can take care of something as simple as buying a guitar.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Even if you do, you gonna teach him to play too? And if you can manage that, why not learn for him too while you're at it? May as well make his musical dreams come true in his place!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Huh...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: If you put it that way... I suppose Liv has her new friend, and Lut has something he wants to do. Maybe they really don't need me as much as they did before.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: All of a sudden, it feels like... my heart's breaking—

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: No matter how reluctant you are to let go of the kiddos, time waits for no one. Like it or not, they'll grow up sooner or later.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: They'll decide on a direction for their own lives, just like you're deciding to leave Siesta now.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: But I don't want to miss out on seeing them grow up either...

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Look at the way Lut is introducing those products to tourists, all serious and stuff. Doesn't he remind you of someone?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Back on the beaches of Old Siesta, a certain young Enis selling bottled soda to tourists wherever he went.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: It's true that you might not be able to be with your siblings in the days to come. But during your time together, you've already left a subtle mark on how they think and act.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: As they grow up, the memories y'all made in the 'White Volcano' will accompany them in your place.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Our memories... the 'White Volcano.'

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I think I get it now... So that's why Harley was so opposed to tearing it down before.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: That said, you were a way smarter kid than Lut.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: I mean, you'd secretly swap out all the condiments at the BBQ shack to spicy ones, and then stand around peddling your ice-cold sodas like you did nothing wrong.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I can't believe you still remember that...

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Who'd ever forget taking a bite of lava-hot BBQ?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I just wanted the store to sell out quick.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: That way we'd be able to get off work early, so Harley could get back to practicing her new songs with her old bandmates, and I'd be able to go swimming with Lut and Liv.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Speaking of which, those two had just joined the family at the time. Their tiny little hands couldn't even hold onto the floats, so I had to strap the floats to their backs so they could flop around in the shallow water while holding onto my arms.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: And in the blink of an eye, they're... Time sure flies, doesn't it?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: These are all... our family memories.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Thanks, Grandpa Tom! I'm gonna head over to the waterpark construction site real quick!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I finally figured out what I want to do before I leave!

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Young folks sure have a lot of energy.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: I remember when you first came to Siesta. Just like Enis, you seemed like an endless bundle of energy.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: So, what'd you think of my choice of words?
The door handle of the cold drinks shop slowly turns, and the door begins to open.
A woman walks out of the shop and looks at the old shopkeeper leisurely basking in the sun on the awning.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Spoken like a sage.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: I'd expect nothing less from Tom, the man older than Fashion Street itself. What are some minor family troubles to him?

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Thanks to your notes, I didn't make a total fool of myself.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: But if you had everything all figured out, why not talk to Enis yourself? Why make an outsider like me give him that push on the back?

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Good question.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Hahaha. You were actually in a pretty good mood when you said goodbye to Chuck. Drinkin' and singing just as always.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: But it's totally different when it's your son's turn to leave the nest. Dunno if it's because you're a mother or... maybe you should've swapped places with Chuck, who's out there livin' his best life.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: As if! My traveling days ended the moment I became a mom.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: I owe you a glass of something nice.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Then let me try your new creation, the 'Cotton Sunset.'

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Mind a little chili powder?

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Wouldn't have it any other way.
*clink, clink*
*swish, swish*

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I think this is what the house number sign was like before. Hmm, the length doesn't seem quite right. Need to trim it a little bit over here.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: No good, the wood's too soft. I'll have to use stone after all.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Let me see... There's still some rocks I can use from the ones I brought over from the construction site.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: This piece looks decent enough. Alright, better finish up before they get back!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Can't wait to see the looks on their faces.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Huh... Why am I getting a nosebleed again?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Maybe it's because I'm brimming with energy and enthusiasm!

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Enis!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Huh? H-Harley? Why are you back so early—

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Those rocks, the lumps of mud... You little— Are you secretly practicing your Arts again? Did the doctor's words go in one ear and out the other?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Wait! I can explain!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (Wipes nosebleed)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Look. Chisel, hammer, saw.. I made these with my own two hands! No Arts involved!

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: What's all this?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Can't tell yet, right? All you need to do is raise this 'roof' up, and—

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Tadah! Welcome back to the original 'White Volcano'!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: How does it look? What about this model over here? I made every little piece of this, bit by bit! Look at this sign—doesn't it look identical to the one that was on old Fashion Street?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Unfortunately my sculpting skills aren't quite up to par... The little refrigerator's handle is a bit crooked.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: So, this is the surprise you wanted to leave for us before you go?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: It isn't something I made alone.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: It's not done yet. It's still missing a few of its most important parts. The rest needs to be finished together, as a family.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: This is for you.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: A clay doll? Is this supposed to be me? What's with the fro?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: It was originally supposed to be braids, but I accidentally lopped 'em off so I figured I might as well change it to a fro... Besides, didn't you have that really puffy hairstyle when I was a kid? I always thought it was pretty neat.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: I've seen worse.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: But the OG 'White Volcano' didn't look like that. The beach chairs and inflatable boats were only added after the expansion.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: More precisely, after Liv and Lut were born.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: But it was only then that 'White Volcano' became complete. These are supposed to be our memories.

spans.text: But it was only then that 'White Volcano' became complete. These are supposed to be

steps.name: Lut & Liv
steps.text: We're back!

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: Huh? What's that?

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: It's a mini 'White Volcano'!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I made a miniature of it. How's it look? Pretty sweet, right?

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: Standing in front of the door... Is that you and Harley?

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: They're tiny clay figures!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Mmhmm, that's right! Members of the adventure team, where are your dolls? Put 'em over here!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: And our two new little friends as well—

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: Whoa... It's a fluffy little sheep doll!

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: Plus a D32 steel warrior!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: No, no. This is Colonel Orirock!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: He followed us home, his stony heart moved after seeing how hard Colonel Lut was working at the music shop, even at his young age!

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: (How'd Enis find out? Did you spill the beans?!)

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: (I... I swear it wasn't me! You must've let it slip 'cause you're so dumb!)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Ahem... Um, in any case! Colonel Orirock over here, just like me, is eagerly looking forward to Colonel Lut purchasing his first guitar and beginning his musical journey.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Lut, by the time I get back, you better have learned a few songs from Harley!

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Hey. I never agreed to teach him.

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: Guitar?

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: ...What guitar?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Huh? Didn't you go to the instruments shop because you wanted to buy a guitar?

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: I guess Enis is even dumber than you are, Lut.

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: I think you should just tell him.
The young boy shrugs, takes a small wooden box from his little backpack, and places it in Enis's hands.
Upon it is a neat array of smooth metal sheets, its end tapering off in a beautiful arc, just like the waves bestowed upon the beach by the ocean.
On the box's surface is the 'White Volcano' logo, drawn with colored pens. Pasted next to it is a pink fluffy sheep, looking like it's about to eat it in one bite.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: This is... a kalimba?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Are you giving it to me?

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: Mhm. This was the deal between me and the shop owner. Liv here drew the logo.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (Hugs)

steps.name: Lut
steps.text: Urk...

steps.name: Liv
steps.text: Hey! Enis! Too tight!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Lut... Liv... Thank you so much.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Wonderful.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Looks like Lut and Liv know you well enough to understand that you're a musical dunce who can barely even play the kalimba.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: ...Harley, can we not kill the good vibes for now?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Alright, mission accomplished!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I guess we can put this miniature in front of the store, like a kind of mascot.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: After the waterpark is built, tourists will come by and ask, 'what's this little house?'

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: You should be more worried about drunkards puking all over it, instead of imagining people admiring your masterpiece.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Well, I trust you'll be able to prevent that!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: After all, this is the only way I'm gonna be here with you for a while: as this little doll living inside the model.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Hmph. Just stay well. That's the best gift you can get us.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Also, don't you think there's still something missing from it?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: ...My goodness!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I forgot to put Chuck in!

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Enis! Rush delivery for you!

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Thank heaven n' earth that the last one was made out to you. Otherwise I'd be out here griping how tedious this whole day's been.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: A rush delivery? I wonder who it's from...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: The sender is... Ch-Chuck?!
With great anticipation, the youth opens the cardboard box sent from afar.
Wrapped up in layers of old newspapers is a little straw doll made from dried vines.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: It looks a bit like Chuck, huh?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Wait, his backpack... seems to be made from folded paper? There's something written inside.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: 'Son, I heard you were leaving 'White Volcano?''

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: 'Tell Harley I left a little 'golden happiness' in our family bank account.'

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: That's just like him.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: I hope he meant lodging money for Lut and Liv's next semester, and not a bill of debt.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: 'The locals made this straw doll for me when I was in Bolívar. Does it look as buff as me?'
A sudden gust of wind blows by, and the straw man's limbs flop around like reeds.
Its hat of leaves also blows right off, revealing a bald head underneath.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: 'Have him see you off in my place!'

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: 'Being on the road isn't an easy thing. So, have you figured out where you're going? And how you're going to get there?'

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: 'I look forward to hearing your answer by the next time we get together.'
A few regulars lift the entryway's curtains, and the mother invites them to take a seat before the sound of ice cubes dancing in the shaker fills the room.
The laughter of his young siblings reaches his ears. For a moment, it's as if he is whisked away to the beach, back to the little store of his childhood.
The young man looks towards the end of Fashion Street, and before he knows it, the setting sun's afterglow has already composed the score for a perfectly ordinary night.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Finally, it's time to go.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Now then, what will the future have in store?
